title: Crispy Fried Chicken Bites
description: Crispy fried chicken bites with a crunchy crumbly coating, perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, mix together flour, peruvian crumble, and garlic powder.
2. Dip each chicken piece into the flour mixture, coating evenly.
3. Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C.
4. Fry the chicken pieces in batches until golden brown and crispy.
5. Remove the fried chicken from the oil and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
6. Serve the crispy fried chicken bites hot and enjoy!
